goal: Specify every screen of the new Admin, especially a per-feature AI configuration screen for each of the seven AI features, mapping each field to the backend table or function it reads or writes, marking what exists versus what needs new SQL or Edge Function work, and recording the Owner decisions of 2026-11-04.
successCriteria: docs/proposals/ADMIN_SCREENS_SPEC_2026-11-04.vi.md covers Login, Overview, Guides, Deck and 78 cards, In-app copy, AI features list, seven per-feature configuration variants, Providers and models, Prompts and versions, Test runs and scoring, User feedback, AI log and Action history.
Each field names its backend source and a status label (existing, new SQL, new Edge Function, admin-only, storage, locked in code).
The rollout A0-A7 and the Owner decisions of 2026-11-04 are recorded; PLAN.md points to the spec and the design canvas.
untouchedSurfaces: No Admin, mobile or backend code change.
No SQL, migration, Edge Function deploy, secret or provider setting change.
Design canvas lives outside the repository as a private artifact.

impact.dataWrite: No data is written or migrated; the slice only adds documents.
impact.backendContract: None changed; new tables and functions are proposals for later Owner-approved slices.
impact.privacySafety: Spec narrows data sent to models: no full journal text, mood labels only within 24 hours, no birth data for reports.
impact.observability: No new events, traces or logs are added.
impact.rollback: Revert the commit; documents have no runtime effect.

canonicalContracts: Owner-approved Admin navigation (ADMIN_REDESIGN_2026-11-03 section 5); LLM fallback Phase 0; account-tier-policy.json and ai-usage-policy.json limits.
